name: Ommetaphobia
source:
You hadn’t seen Zev like this before: IV hooked, one arm bright red, cubes scattered at his feet. He meets your gaze, humor masking fear. “I have no control,” he says. 

The parasite pulses beneath his skin, alive and aware. You feel its presence as clearly as his eyes on you.

[From [url=https://f1nkofficial.itch.io/ommetaphobiademo]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你以前从未见过这样的泽夫：IV被钩住，一只手臂呈鲜红色，立方体散落在他的脚下。他与你的目光相遇，幽默掩盖了恐惧。“我无法控制，”他说。

寄生虫在他的皮肤下搏动，活着并且有意识。你能清楚地感觉到它的存在，就像他注视着你一样。

[来自[url=https://f1nkofficial.itch.io/ommetaphobiademo]Itch.io[/url]]
